fees.notes: AEU does not publish fees publicly. Contact university for current fee schedule. Financial aid available: PTPTN loan, EPF withdrawal, merit scholarship, 10% early settlement discount, 10% loyalty discount, 50% senior citizen discount, 75% disability discount.

requirements.direct_entry: STPM Grade C+ (GP 2.33) in two subjects; OR STAM Jayyid; OR Matriculation/Foundation CGPA 2.50; OR Diploma (Level 4 MQF) CGPA 2.50; OR Diploma in Accounting fields CGPA 2.50 (CGPA 2.00-2.50 subject to assessment); OR DKM/DVM in Accounting CGPA 2.50; OR DLKM in Accounting CGPA 2.50; OR Advanced Diploma (Level 5 MQF) CGPA 2.50; OR other equivalent qualifications. AND Credit in Mathematics at SPM level. AND MUET Band 3.0 or Credit in English at SPM.
requirements.apel_entry: Minimum 21 years of age with relevant working experience.
requirements.english_requirement: MUET Band 3.0 or Credit in English at SPM (Malaysian students). IELTS equivalent for international students.
requirements.other_qualifications: DKM/DVM/DLKM in Accounting fields accepted with CGPA 2.50
